title: Elephant dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#8ec5e8'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#b8ddf5'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='16' fill='#8ec5e8'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='11' fill='#b8ddf5'/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='30' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#6aabd4'/>
  <!-- Left ear inner -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='30' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#f5b8d0'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='30' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#6aabd4'/>
  <!-- Right ear inner -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='30' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#f5b8d0'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='3' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='3' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Trunk -->
  <path d='M50 36 Q48 48 38 52 Q32 55 34 60' stroke='#8ec5e8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 36 Q48 48 38 52 Q32 55 34 60' stroke='#b8ddf5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Trunk tip -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='60' r='4' fill='#6aabd4'/>
  <!-- Dancing leg highlights -->
  <!-- Left front leg (raised) -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='10' height='16' rx='5' fill='#8ec5e8' transform='rotate(-20 35 80)'/>
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='5' height='16' rx='3' fill='#b8ddf5' transform='rotate(-20 35 80)'/>
  <!-- Right front leg (raised) -->
  <rect x='60' y='72' width='10' height='16' rx='5' fill='#8ec5e8' transform='rotate(20 65 80)'/>
  <rect x='65' y='72' width='5' height='16' rx='3' fill='#b8ddf5' transform='rotate(20 65 80)'/>
  <!-- Left back leg -->
  <rect x='38' y='74' width='10' height='14' rx='5' fill='#6aabd4'/>
  <!-- Right back leg -->
  <rect x='52' y='74' width='10' height='14' rx='5' fill='#6aabd4'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M76 55 Q84 50 82 44' stroke='#8ec5e8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail tuft -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='44' r='3' fill='#f5b8d0'/>
  <!-- Musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd966'>
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='20' rx='4' ry='3' transform='rotate(-20 24 20)'/>
    <rect x='27' y='8' width='2' height='13'/>
    <path d='M27 8 Q33 6 32 12' fill='none' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffd966'>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='16' rx='4' ry='3' transform='rotate(-20 78 16)'/>
    <rect x='81' y='4' width='2' height='13'/>
    <path d='M81 4 Q87 2 86 8' fill='none' stroke='#ffd966' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Dance sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='70' r='2' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='65' r='2' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='2' fill='#ffd966'/>
</svg>
